custom/ionix/vpn.label: VPN
custom/ionix/vpn.execute: if oc s | grep -q 'connected to VPN'; then echo '{"alt": "connected", "text": "Connected"}'; else echo '{"alt": "disconnected", "text": "Not Connected"}'; fi

actions.onMiddleClick: if oc dc; then notify-send 'VPN Disconnected' 'You have been disconnected from the VPN.'; else oc p && notify-send 'VPN Connected' 'Connected to primary VPN.'; fi

custom/ionix/vpn-windscribe.label: WS
custom/ionix/vpn-windscribe.execute: status=$(windscribe-cli status 2>/dev/null); state=$(echo "$status" | grep 'Connect state:' | cut -d: -f2- | xargs); if echo "$state" | grep -qi '^connected'; then echo '{"alt": "connected", "text": "Connected"}'; else echo '{"alt": "disconnected", "text": "Not Connected"}'; fi

actions.onMiddleClick: if windscribe-cli status | grep -q 'Connect state: Connected'; then windscribe-cli disconnect && notify-send 'Windscribe' 'Disconnected'; else windscribe-cli connect best && notify-send 'Windscribe' 'Connected to best location'; fi
